description: Provision of social protection in the form of cash benefits and benefits in kind that replace in whole or in part loss of earnings during a temporary inability to work due to sickness or injury. Includes sickness benefits paid in cash or in kind, including paid sick leave compensation; administration, operation or support of such schemes.
includes: paid sick leave, sickness benefits in cash to compensate for loss of earnings during a temporary inability to work due to sickness or injury
sickness benefits in kind, such as assistance in carrying out daily tasks (in-home help, transport facilities, laundry)
administration, operation or support of such social protection schemes
excludes: benefits provided in connection with employment-related injury or disease, see 1012
cash and in-kind health benefits provided as part of medical services (07xx)
family and children benefits paid during maternity leave, see 1040
